short_description: Launching a surprise attack from the Ghost Currents on Vex's anchored ship at the heart of the Crimson Depths
weather: Swirling crimson maelstrom with spectral mist remnants

text_blocks.content: SURPRISE FROM THE MISTS
Edge of the Ghost Currents - Crimson Depths Border
You give Quinn a sharp nod. 'Now. Full attack.'
'Aye, Captain! Gunners, ready starboard broadside! Prepare to cut through that coral ring!'
Your ship surges forward, tearing through the thinning mist like a blade. The spectral faces in the Ghost Currents wail in silent protest as you break the sacred quiet. Your cannons roar to life.
BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM
Cannonballs arc through the crimson-lit air, trailing glowing mist like comets. They smash into the pulsating coral ring protecting Vex's ship.
The coral shrieks—an actual sound, high and piercing—as it shatters. Chunks of glowing red mineral fly through the air. Through the gap, you see figures scrambling on the decks of the Siren's Call.
Surprise is complete. But for how long? Vex has survived this long in these deadly waters. He won't be caught unprepared for long.
Vex appears at the stern of his ship, the coral crown glowing fiercely. He raises a hand, and the swirling waters of the maelstrom respond, forming protective walls of frothing seawater.
'You shouldn't have come here, Captain! The Depths don't take kindly to uninvited guests!'
The sea itself seems to rise against you. Tentacles of crimson water lash toward your ship. Quinn spins the wheel hard, dodging the first assault.
'He's controlling the Depths! The crown—it's giving him command of the water itself!'
CRACK-SPLINTER-WHOOSH
Your ship closes the distance. Boarding planks slam down onto the Siren's Call. Your crew surges across, cutlasses flashing in the bloody light.
Chaos erupts on both decks. Steel clashes. Men shout. The two ships are locked together now, spinning slowly in the heart of the Crimson Depths.
This was the plan. Get to Vex. Take the crown. But seeing him command the sea itself... Is this power worth having? Is it power at all, or just a different kind of slavery?
Vex fights his way toward you, cutting down anyone in his path. The coral crown pulses with each step, and the waters around the ships churn in response.
'You think you can take what's mine? The sea chose me! It showed me its memories, its power!'
He's twenty feet away now. The battle rages around you. Quinn is holding off three of Vex's men near the mainmast. The ships groan as the maelstrom tries to pull them apart.
Vex stands before you, the coral crown glowing with the power of the Crimson Depths. The battle hangs in the balance.
